description: Get account state (positions, margin) on a HyperLiquid DEX. No auth. Builder/HIP-3 positions (e.g. xyz:NVDA) live under their own dex — pass `dex` ("xyz") to see them. The default query does NOT show builder positions; an open builder position will look empty without `dex`.

dex.description: Builder/HIP-3 dex prefix, e.g. "xyz". Omit for the default USDC dex.

name: get_hl_clearinghouse_state
